verses.original: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ διὰ θελήματος Θεοῦ Τοῖς ἁγίοις τοῖς οὖσιν ἐν Ἐφέσῳ καὶ πιστοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Paulos apostolos Christou Iēsou dia thelēmatos Theou Tois hagiois tois ousin en Ephesō kai pistois en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: Paul an apostle of Christ Jesus by [the] will of God To the saints - - in Ephesus - [the] faithful in Christ Jesus

verses.original: Χάρις καὶ εἰρήνη ὑμῖν ἀπὸ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν Πατρὸς καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Charis kai eirēnē hymin apo Theou hēmōn Patros kai Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and [the] Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: Εὐλογητὸς ὁ Θεὸς καὶ Πατὴρ ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ὁ εὐλογήσας ἡμᾶς ἐν Χριστῷ ἐν πάσῃ πνευματικῇ εὐλογίᾳ ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις
verses.transliteration: Eulogētos ho Theos kai Patēr hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou ho eulogēsas hēmas en Christō en pasē pneumatikē eulogia en tois epouraniois
verses.literal: Blessed [be] the God and Father of our - Lord Jesus Christ who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms

verses.original: καθὼς ἐξελέξατο ἡμᾶς ἐν αὐτῷ πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου ἡμᾶς εἶναι ἁγίους καὶ ἀμώμους κατενώπιον αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀγάπῃ
verses.transliteration: kathōs exelexato hēmas en autō pro katabolēs kosmou hēmas einai hagious kai amōmous katenōpion autou en agapē
verses.literal: For He chose us in Him before [the] foundation of [the] world - to be holy and blameless in His presence . . . In love

verses.original: προορίσας ἡμᾶς εἰς υἱοθεσίαν εἰς αὐτόν διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ κατὰ τὴν εὐδοκίαν τοῦ αὐτοῦ θελήματος
verses.transliteration: proorisas hēmas eis huiothesian eis auton dia Iēsou Christou kata tēn eudokian tou autou thelēmatos
verses.literal: He predestined us for adoption as His sons . . . . . . through Jesus Christ according to the good pleasure of His will

verses.original: εἰς ἔπαινον τῆς αὐτοῦ δόξης χάριτος ἧς ἐχαρίτωσεν ἡμᾶς ἐν τῷ Ἠγαπημένῳ
verses.transliteration: eis epainon tēs autou doxēs charitos hēs echaritōsen hēmas en tō Ēgapēmenō
verses.literal: to [the] praise of His glorious grace which He has freely given us in the Beloved [One]

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ ἔχομεν τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν διὰ αὐτοῦ τοῦ αἵματος τὴν ἄφεσιν τῶν παραπτωμάτων κατὰ τὸ πλοῦτος τῆς αὐτοῦ χάριτος
verses.transliteration: en hō echomen tēn apolytrōsin dia autou tou haimatos tēn aphesin tōn paraptōmatōn kata to ploutos tēs autou charitos
verses.literal: In [Him] we have - redemption through His - blood the forgiveness of our trespasses according to the riches of His grace

verses.original: ἧς ἐπερίσσευσεν εἰς ἡμᾶς ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ καὶ φρονήσει
verses.transliteration: hēs eperisseusen eis hēmas en pasē sophia kai phronēsei
verses.literal: that He lavished on us with all wisdom and understanding

verses.original: γνωρίσας ἡμῖν τὸ μυστήριον αὐτοῦ τοῦ θελήματος κατὰ αὐτοῦ τὴν εὐδοκίαν ἣν προέθετο ἐν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: gnōrisas hēmin to mystērion autou tou thelēmatos kata autou tēn eudokian hēn proetheto en autō
verses.literal: [And] He has made known to us the mystery of His - will according to His - good pleasure which He purposed in [Christ]

verses.original: εἰς οἰκονομίαν τοῦ πληρώματος τῶν καιρῶν ἀνακεφαλαιώσασθαι πάντα τὰ ἐπὶ τοῖς οὐρανοῖς καὶ τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ τὰ
verses.transliteration: eis oikonomian tou plērōmatos tōn kairōn anakephalaiōsasthai panta ta epi tois ouranois kai ta epi tēs gēs en tō Christō ta
verses.literal: as a plan for the fullness of time to bring all things - in - heaven and - on - earth {together} in - Christ -

verses.original: ἐν αὐτῷ ἐν ᾧ καὶ ἐκληρώθημεν προορισθέντες κατὰ πρόθεσιν τοῦ ἐνεργοῦντος τὰ πάντα κατὰ τὴν βουλὴν τοῦ αὐτοῦ θελήματος
verses.transliteration: en autō en hō kai eklērōthēmen prooristhentes kata prothesin tou energountos ta panta kata tēn boulēn tou autou thelēmatos
verses.literal: In Him - - vvv we were also chosen as God’s own having been predestined according to [the] plan of [Him who] works out - everything by the counsel of His will

verses.original: εἰς ἡμᾶς τοὺς προηλπικότας ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ τὸ εἶναι εἰς ἔπαινον αὐτοῦ δόξης
verses.transliteration: eis hēmas tous proēlpikotas en tō Christō to einai eis epainon autou doxēs
verses.literal: in order that we who were the first to hope in - Christ - would be for [the] praise of His glory

verses.original: καὶ ἐν ᾧ ἀκούσαντες καὶ πιστεύσαντες τὸν λόγον τῆς ἀληθείας τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς ὑμῶν σωτηρίας ὑμεῖς ἐσφραγίσθητε τῷ τῷ τῆς ἐπαγγελίας Ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι ἐν ᾧ
verses.transliteration: kai en hō akousantes kai pisteusantes ton logon tēs alētheias to euangelion tēs hymōn sōtērias hymeis esphragisthēte tō tō tēs epangelias Hagiō Pneumati en hō
verses.literal: And in [Him] having heard and believed the word - of truth the gospel of your salvation you were sealed with the - promised Holy Spirit - -

verses.original: ὅ ἐστιν ἀρραβὼν ἡμῶν τῆς κληρονομίας εἰς ἀπολύτρωσιν τῆς περιποιήσεως εἰς ἔπαινον τῆς αὐτοῦ δόξης
verses.transliteration: ho estin arrabōn hēmōn tēs klēronomias eis apolytrōsin tēs peripoiēseōs eis epainon tēs autou doxēs
verses.literal: who is [the] pledge of our - inheritance until [the] redemption of those [who are] [God’s] possession to [the] praise of His glory

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο κἀγώ ἀκούσας τὴν καθ’ ὑμᾶς πίστιν ἐν τῷ Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ καὶ τὴν ἀγάπην τὴν εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους
verses.transliteration: Dia touto kagō akousas tēn kath’ hymas pistin en tō Kyriō Iēsou kai tēn agapēn tēn eis pantas tous hagious
verses.literal: For this reason . . . ever since I heard about - vvv your faith in the Lord Jesus and [your] love - for all the saints

verses.original: οὐ παύομαι εὐχαριστῶν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ποιούμενος μνείαν ἐπὶ μου τῶν προσευχῶν
verses.transliteration: ou pauomai eucharistōn hyper hymōn poioumenos mneian epi mou tōn proseuchōn
verses.literal: {I have} not stopped giving thanks for you vvv remembering you in my - prayers

verses.original: ἵνα ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ὁ τῆς δόξης Πατὴρ δώῃ ὑμῖν πνεῦμα σοφίας καὶ ἀποκαλύψεως ἐν ἐπιγνώσει αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: hina ho Theos hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou ho tēs doxēs Patēr dōē hymin pneuma sophias kai apokalypseōs en epignōsei autou
verses.literal: that the God of our - Lord Jesus Christ the - glorious Father may give you [a] spirit of wisdom and revelation in [your] knowledge of Him

verses.original: τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς τῆς ὑμῶν καρδίας πεφωτισμένους εἰς ὑμᾶς τὸ εἰδέναι τίς ἐστιν ἡ ἐλπὶς τῆς αὐτοῦ κλήσεως τίς ὁ πλοῦτος τῆς αὐτοῦ τῆς δόξης κληρονομίας ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις
verses.transliteration: tous ophthalmous tēs hymōn kardias pephōtismenous eis hymas to eidenai tis estin hē elpis tēs autou klēseōs tis ho ploutos tēs autou tēs doxēs klēronomias en tois hagiois
verses.literal: [I ask that] the eyes of your heart may be enlightened so that you - may know - - the hope of His calling - the riches of His vvv glorious inheritance in the saints

verses.original: καὶ τί τὸ ὑπερβάλλον μέγεθος τῆς αὐτοῦ δυνάμεως εἰς ἡμᾶς τοὺς πιστεύοντας κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν τῆς αὐτοῦ ἰσχύος τοῦ κράτους
verses.transliteration: kai ti to hyperballon megethos tēs autou dynameōs eis hēmas tous pisteuontas kata tēn energeian tēs autou ischyos tou kratous
verses.literal: and - the surpassing greatness of His power to us who believe [ These are ] in accordance with the working of His mighty - strength

verses.original: ἣν ἐνήργηκεν ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ ἐγείρας αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν καὶ καθίσας ἐν αὐτοῦ δεξιᾷ ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις
verses.transliteration: hēn enērgēken en tō Christō egeiras auton ek nekrōn kai kathisas en autou dexia en tois epouraniois
verses.literal: which He exerted in - Christ when He raised Him from [the] dead and seated [Him] at His right hand in the heavenly realms

verses.original: ὑπεράνω πάσης ἀρχῆς καὶ ἐξουσίας καὶ δυνάμεως καὶ κυριότητος καὶ παντὸς ὀνόματος ὀνομαζομένου οὐ μόνον ἐν τούτῳ τῷ αἰῶνι ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐν τῷ μέλλοντι
verses.transliteration: hyperanō pasēs archēs kai exousias kai dynameōs kai kyriotētos kai pantos onomatos onomazomenou ou monon en toutō tō aiōni alla kai en tō mellonti
verses.literal: far above all rule and authority - power and dominion and every name that is named not only in the present - age but also in the [one] to come

verses.original: καὶ ὑπέταξεν πάντα ὑπὸ αὐτοῦ τοὺς πόδας καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὸν κεφαλὴν ὑπὲρ πάντα τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ
verses.transliteration: kai hypetaxen panta hypo autou tous podas kai edōken auton kephalēn hyper panta tē ekklēsia
verses.literal: And [God] put everything under His - feet and made Him head over everything for the church

verses.original: ἥτις ἐστὶν αὐτοῦ τὸ σῶμα τὸ πλήρωμα τοῦ πληρουμένου τὰ πάντα ἐν πᾶσιν
verses.transliteration: hētis estin autou to sōma to plērōma tou plēroumenou ta panta en pasin
verses.literal: which is His - body the fullness of [Him] who fills - all in all
